description: Chang Guang Satellite Technology and China Agricultural University publish multispectral surface-reflectance imagery for selected black-soil areas in northeastern China. JL1GP observations at five- to twenty-metre resolution are calibrated, atmospherically corrected and orthorectified. ScienceDB assigns CC BY 4.0 for free reuse. The inspected metadata does not establish the image-acquisition period, complete geographic footprints or file format. These reflectance products can support land-cover and soil-surface parameter estimation for agricultural and erosion simulations. The provider reports seven-percent absolute radiometric accuracy, but that is not an accuracy statement for any derived soil property. Coverage is limited to selected clear-sky scenes. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: A dataset of JLS-5-20M black soil image in Northeast China
